name: Baby scratch
lesson:
## Forward, back, in time

Crossfader open the whole time. Move jog A forward for an eighth note, back for an eighth, and repeat: eight strokes a bar for 4 bars at 95 BPM. The sound is the sample going forwards and backwards; the skill is that each stroke is the same length and lands on the grid.

Every other scratch is a baby scratch with the fader doing something, which is why this is first. On a controller jog the sample follows your hand only while you touch the top plate; keep the fingers on the platter for the whole stroke and let go only between bars. Digital DJ Tips' point stands: the jog is not a turntable, but the hand movement is identical.
